parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainName
parameters.description: The name of the network domain.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainType
parameters.description:
The type of the network domain. Valid values:

- **Direct**: direct connection

- **Proxy**: proxy connection

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, 20 entries are returned on each page.
> Do not leave the PageSize value empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about regions and zones, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
